name: How long does it take to install an entry door?
description: Most standard entry door installations take one day. Complex projects with structural adjustments may require two days.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install an entry door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard entry door installations can be completed within a single day. This typically includes removing the old door and frame, preparing the opening, installing the new pre-hung door unit, and finishing the trim. More complex projects involving structural adjustments, custom door sizes, or extensive frame damage might require two days. We will provide a precise timeline after assessing your specific installation needs.
